subject: London roadshow — spend authorization and PO routing
messages:
From: Oliver Kent <okent@brightbridge.co>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Huang <sara@lumosventures.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 14:14:00 +0000
Subject: Estimate and PO path for London customer roadshow

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — thanks again for confirming the London stop for the Lumos customer roadshow (Nov 18). Attached is our latest estimate for site fees, AV, catering, and on-site staff (Estimate_London-Roadshow_v3.xlsx). Total estimate: £17,950 (inclusive of local VAT).

Quick ask: can Redwood either (A) accept invoicing from BrightBridge Events (we’d send an invoice payable within 30 days) or (B) issue a PO so BrightBridge can invoice Redwood directly? Lumos has asked that spend be routed via Redwood where possible for visibility. If Redwood needs us to invoice Lumos directly instead, let us know and we’ll coordinate with their AP team, but that will add an extra 5–7 day lead time.

Also include any PO number or cost center you need on the invoice. If there’s a preferred vendor W9/VAT form you need from us, say the word.

Attached: Estimate_London-Roadshow_v3.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,
Oliver Kent
Director, Production
BrightBridge Events
okent@brightbridge.co

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Estimate and PO path for London customer roadshow

Hi Oliver — thanks for the estimate and the quick turnaround.

I’ve looped in Finance (Laura) and CS Ops (Sean) to confirm routing. We want to keep this on Redwood’s books if possible so Lumos sees the spend centrally. Two immediate items from our side:

- Can BrightBridge send a short SOW with a single-line signature (total amount and payment terms)? That will speed Procurement.
- We need the invoice to reference a Redwood PO number and the cost center/GL combo (I’ll confirm once Finance signs off).

Laura — FYI, vendor estimate ~£18k. Can Finance provisionally approve up to £18k pending PO generation? Also, any P-card limits we should be aware of (vendor prefers invoice but can accept payment via card if needed).

Oliver — I’ve attached our SOW template (for fields only) and a sample PO request form. If you can return the signed SOW by COB Mon (Nov 1), that would keep us on track for issuing the PO before the event.

Next steps:
1) BrightBridge returns signed SOW + bank/VAT info
2) Finance issues PO and provides PO number + cost center
3) BrightBridge invoices Redwood referencing PO

Appreciate it — Marissa

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_Template.docx, PO_Request_Form.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:46:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Estimate and PO path for London customer roadshow

Marissa / Sean — I reviewed the estimate and spoke with Procurement. Finance can provisionally approve up to £18,000 for the Lumos roadshow provided the following conditions are met:

- BrightBridge invoices Redwood directly and the invoice references the Redwood PO number
- Cost center: 4302 (EMEA Events)
- GL code: 6101 (Marketing - Events)
- Standard 30-day payment terms; vendor to confirm VAT invoices include our company name (Redwood Inference) and registered address

Procurement has asked that we issue a PO before the vendor receives payment. I’ve created a DocuSign SOW link for BrightBridge to sign; please include it in your reply.

Vanessa — please confirm whether the spend requires a P-card exception for any on-site deposits (we typically avoid P-card for >£5k unless pre-approved).

Oliver/ BrightBridge — once you sign the SOW and confirm bank details, Procurement will issue a PO (we aim for 5 business days from receipt). If the vendor cannot invoice Redwood, we can discuss invoicing Lumos directly but that will require Lumos AP confirmation and could delay payment.

DocuSign (SOW): https://docusign.com/signed/SOW-Lumos-1098 (placeholder)

Thanks — Laura
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Marissa / Laura — thanks for the clarity and the DocuSign link. Attached is the signed SOW (Signed_SOW_Lumos_1098.pdf) and our VAT form. BrightBridge can invoice Redwood directly and we will include the PO number on the invoice once provided. Our standard invoice lead time is 3 business days after PO issuance.

We can accept bank transfer (BACS/SEPA) or card; please confirm preferred payment method on the PO. Also confirm whether we should send invoices to accounts-payable@redwood.com or to your AP partner at Lumos — per your preference above, we’ll route to Redwood.
